api_auth_failed.message: Authentication with the Sure Petcare cloud failed. Re-authenticate the integration (Settings → Devices & Services → Sure Petcare → three-dot menu → Reauthenticate), then retry.

api_connection_failed.message: Could not reach the Sure Petcare cloud. Check your network connection and retry once it is restored.

confirm_required.message: The confirm field must be true to change indoor-only access. Call surepetcare.set_indoor_only again with confirm: true.

device_offline.message: Flap {device_name} ({device_id}) is offline — cannot verify a change; refusing to write. Check the flap's power and hub connectivity, then retry.

invalid_entity.message: {entity_id} is not a Sure Petcare indoor-only switch. Target a switch.<pet>_indoor_only entity of this integration.

no_flap_assignment.message: Pet {pet_name} has no chip assignment on any flap, so indoor-only cannot be set.

switch_write_protected.message: The indoor-only switch is write-protected by design and cannot be toggled directly. Use the surepetcare.set_indoor_only service with confirm: true instead.

verification_failed.message: The indoor-only change could not be verified against the Sure Petcare cloud after the retry budget, so no state was updated. The switch re-syncs from the next cloud read; retry the service call if needed.

set_indoor_only.description: Sets the indoor-only access profile of one or more pets on their flaps. The cloud state is read back and verified before the switch updates.

confirm.description: Must be true — protects against accidental flips.
confirm.name: Confirm

indoor_only.description: true keeps the pet(s) inside (indoor only); false restores normal access.
indoor_only.name: Indoor only

set_indoor_only.name: Set indoor only
